iframe.title: Home | Schoology
iframe.allow: fullscreen; autoplay; gamepad; clipboard-read; clipboard-write; web-share; accelerometer; gyroscope
iframe.srcdoc:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Home | Schoology</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<style>
  :root { --bg:#fff; --fg:#1b1f23; --muted:#666; --card:#f4f5f7; --line:#d8dbe0; --accent:#2563eb; }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root { --bg:#14171a; --fg:#e6e8eb; --muted:#9aa0a6; --card:#1e2327; --line:#2e353b; --accent:#6ea8fe; }
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin:0; min-height:100vh; padding:24px; background:var(--bg); color:var(--fg); font:16px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; }
  header { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; margin-bottom:4px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  h1 { margin:0; font-size:1.5rem; }
  #status { color:var(--muted); margin:0 0 16px; font-size:.9rem; }
  #q { width:100%; max-width:420px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px;
       background:var(--card); color:var(--fg); font-size:1rem; margin-bottom:16px; }
  #list { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill, minmax(230px, 1fr)); gap:10px; }
  a.item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:10px 12px; background:var(--card); border:1px solid var(--line);
           border-radius:8px; color:var(--accent); text-decoration:none; word-break:break-all; }
  a.item:hover { border-color:var(--accent); }
  .ico { width:44px; height:44px; flex:none; border-radius:10px; background:var(--line); color:var(--fg);
         display:grid; place-items:center; font-weight:700; overflow:hidden; }
  .ico img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block; }
  .hbtns { display:flex; gap:8px; }
  .hbtn { padding:8px 14px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; background:var(--card); color:var(--fg);
          font:inherit; cursor:pointer; }
  .hbtn:hover { border-color:var(--accent); }
  #q, a.item { backdrop-filter: blur(6px); }
  #settings { position:fixed; top:64px; right:24px; width:min(320px, calc(100vw - 48px)); z-index:20; padding:16px;
              background:var(--bg); color:var(--fg); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:12px;
              box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35); display:none; }
  #settings.open { display:block; }
  #settings h2 { margin:0 0 10px; font-size:1rem; }
  #settings label { display:block; margin:12px 0 6px; font-size:.85rem; color:var(--muted); }
  .swatches { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4, 1fr); gap:8px; }
  .sw { height:44px; border-radius:8px; border:2px solid var(--line); cursor:pointer; font-size:.7rem; color:#fff;
        display:grid; place-items:center; text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.6); padding:0; }
  .sw.on { border-color:var(--accent); }
  .row { display:flex; gap:8px; }
  .row input[type=text] { flex:1; min-width:0; padding:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; background:var(--card); color:var(--fg); }
  .row input[type=color] { width:44px; height:36px; padding:0; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; background:none; }
  #settings button.small { padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; background:var(--card); color:var(--fg); cursor:pointer; }
  #adminBar { position:fixed; top:-60px; left:0; right:0; z-index:50; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
              padding:10px 16px; background:#111418; color:#f1f5f9; border-bottom:1px solid #333; transition:top .25s ease; }
  #adminBar.open { top:0; }
  #adminBar input { padding:7px 10px; border:1px solid #444; border-radius:6px; background:#1b1f24; color:#fff; }
  #adminBar .small { padding:7px 12px; border:1px solid #444; border-radius:6px; background:#1b1f24; color:#fff; cursor:pointer; font:inherit; }
  #adminBar .small:hover { border-color:#8ec5ff; }
  #adminBar label { font-size:.85rem; color:#aab2bd; }
  #maintOverlay, #flashOverlay { position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:60; display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; }
  #maintOverlay { background:var(--bg); color:var(--fg); text-align:center; }
  #maintOverlay.open, #flashOverlay.open { display:flex; }
  #flashOverlay { background:#000; }
  #flashText { color:#e11d2e; font-size:clamp(2rem, 8vw, 6rem); font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.02em; text-align:center; padding:0 20px; }
  #gate { position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:100; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
          background:var(--bg); color:var(--fg); }
  #gate.hidden { display:none; }
  #gateBox { text-align:center; padding:28px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:12px; background:var(--card); min-width:260px; }
  #gateBox h2 { margin:0 0 6px; }
  #gateBox p { margin:0 0 16px; color:var(--muted); }
  #gateBox input { width:100%; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; background:var(--bg); color:var(--fg); margin-bottom:12px; font-size:1rem; }
  #gateBox .small { padding:9px 16px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; background:var(--accent); color:#fff; cursor:pointer; font:inherit; border:0; }

  #adminBar { flex-wrap:wrap; max-height:55vh; overflow:auto; }
  #adminMenu { flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:100%; }
  #userAdmin { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; align-items:center; width:100%; padding:10px 0 2px; border-top:1px solid #333; }
  #userAdmin select, #userAdmin input, #userAdmin textarea { padding:8px; border:1px solid #444; border-radius:6px; background:#1b1f24; color:#fff; font:inherit; }
  #userAdmin textarea { flex:1 1 220px; min-height:54px; resize:vertical; }
  #userList { flex:1 1 180px; color:#d1d5db; font-size:.85rem; }
  #userPopup { position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:110; display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:20px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.72); }
  #userPopup.open { display:flex; }
  #userPopupBox { width:min(440px,100%); padding:24px; border-radius:14px; background:var(--bg); color:var(--fg); border:1px solid var(--line); box-shadow:0 18px 60px #0008; }
  #userPopupBox h2 { margin:0 0 10px; }
  #userPopupBody { white-space:pre-wrap; overflow-wrap:anywhere; margin:0 0 18px; }

  #hardPopup { position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:200; display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
               padding:20px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.92); }
  #hardPopup.open { display:flex; }
  #hardPopupBox { width:min(520px,100%); padding:28px; border-radius:16px; background:var(--bg); color:var(--fg);
                  border:2px solid var(--line); box-shadow:0 20px 70px #000a; text-align:center; }
  #hardPopupFrom { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:.85rem; opacity:.75; }
  #hardPopupBody { white-space:pre-wrap; overflow-wrap:anywhere; margin:0; font-size:1.25rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.4; }

  #gateSwitch { margin-left:8px; background:transparent!important; color:var(--muted)!important; }

</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="gate">
  <div id="gateBox">
    <h2>Welcome</h2>
    <p>Enter a name to continue.</p>
    <input id="gateName" type="text" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Your name">
    <button id="gateGo" class="small" type="button">Continue</button>
  </div>
</div>

<header><h1>Orangees Games</h1><div class="hbtns"><button id="settingsBtn" class="hbtn" type="button" aria-label="Settings">⚙ Settings</button><button id="adminBtn" class="hbtn" type="button">Admin</button><button id="logoutBtn" class="hbtn" type="button">Log out</button></div></header>

<div id="adminBar">
  <span id="adminPrompt">
    <label for="adminUser">Admin password:</label>
    <input id="adminUser" type="password" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Enter admin password">
    <button id="adminGo" class="small" type="button">Enter</button>
    <span id="adminErr" style="display:none;color:#ff8080;font-size:.85rem">Wrong password</span>
  </span>
  <span id="adminMenu" style="display:none">
    <strong id="adminWho"></strong>
    <button id="admMaint" class="small" type="button">Preview: Under Maintenance</button>
    <button id="admFlash" class="small" type="button">Preview: DO YOUR WORK</button>
    <button id="admSettings" class="small" type="button">Open Settings</button>
    <button id="admLogout" class="small" type="button">Log out</button>
    <div id="userAdmin">
      <strong>Users & popups</strong>
      <span style="font-size:.8rem;color:#aab2bd;width:100%">Works across devices when Firebase is configured (see top of script).</span>
      <span id="userList">No users yet</span>
      <select id="popupTarget" aria-label="Popup recipient"><option value="*">All users</option></select>
      <textarea id="popupMessage" maxlength="500" placeholder="Write a popup message..."></textarea>
      <label style="font-size:.85rem;color:#aab2bd">Text color <input type="color" id="popupColor" value="#f1f5f9" style="width:36px;height:28px;padding:0;border:1px solid #444;border-radius:4px;background:none;vertical-align:middle"></label>
      <label style="font-size:.85rem;color:#aab2bd;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px"><input type="checkbox" id="popupHard" style="width:16px;height:16px"> Hard popup (cannot close)</label>
      <button id="sendPopup" class="small" type="button">Send popup</button>
      <button id="clearHardPopups" class="small" type="button">Remove hard popups</button>
      <button id="refreshUsers" class="small" type="button">Refresh users</button>
      <span id="popupStatus" style="font-size:.8rem;color:#aab2bd"></span>
    </div>
  </span>
  <button id="adminClose" class="small" type="button" aria-label="Close" style="margin-left:auto">×</button>
</div>

<div id="userPopup" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="userPopupTitle">
  <div id="userPopupBox">
    <h2 id="userPopupTitle">Message</h2>
    <p id="userPopupBody"></p>
    <button id="userPopupClose" class="small" type="button">Close</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="hardPopup" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="hardPopupTitle">
  <div id="hardPopupBox">
    <p id="hardPopupFrom"></p>
    <p id="hardPopupBody"></p>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="maintOverlay">
  <div>
    <h2>Under Maintenance</h2>
    <p>We're updating this page. Check back soon.</p>
    <button id="maintExit" class="small" type="button">Exit preview</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="flashOverlay">
  <div id="flashText"></div>
  <button id="flashExit" class="small" type="button">Exit preview</button>
</div>
<p id="status">Loading file list…</p>
<input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Search…" autocomplete="off">
<div id="list"></div>

<div id="settings">
  <h2>Settings</h2>
  <label>Background</label>
  <div class="swatches" id="swatches"></div>
  <label>Custom color</label>
  <div class="row"><input type="color" id="colorPick" value="#1e293b"></div>
  <label>Custom image (link)</label>
  <div class="row"><input type="text" id="imgUrl" placeholder="https://…/picture.jpg"><button class="small" id="imgGo" type="button">Set</button></div>
  <label>or pick an image from your computer</label>
  <div class="row"><input type="file" id="imgFile" accept="image/*"></div>
  <div class="row" style="margin-top:14px"><button class="small" id="resetBg" type="button">Reset</button></div>
</div>

const status = document.getElementById("status");
const list = document.getElementById("list");
const q = document.getElementById("q");
let files = [];   // [name, sizeBytes]
let hidden = 0;

const enc = p => p.split("/").map(encodeURIComponent).join("/");

async function fromJsDelivr() {
  const r = await fetch(`https://data.jsdelivr.com/v1/package/gh/${USER}/${REPO}@${BRANCH}/flat`);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error("jsDelivr " + r.status);
  const d = await r.json();
  return d.files.map(f => [f.name.replace(/^\//, ""), f.size]);
}
async function fromGitHub() {
  const r = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${USER}/${REPO}/git/trees/${BRANCH}?recursive=1`);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error("GitHub " + r.status);
  const d = await r.json();
  return d.tree.filter(t => t.type === "blob").map(t => [t.path, t.size]);
}

// ---------- icons: looked up automatically by game name ----------
const cache = (() => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("iconCache") || "{}"); } catch (e) { return {}; } })();
const saveCache = () => { try { localStorage.setItem("iconCache", JSON.stringify(cache)); } catch (e) {} };
const displayName = f => f.replace(/\.svg$/i, "").replace(/-/g, " ");

function searchTerm(f) {
  let n = displayName(f).replace(/\(\d+\)/g, "").replace(/\bwasm\b/ig, "").replace(/[-_]+/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  if (/^[\d. ]+$/.test(n) || /^(alpha|beta|indev|infdev)\b/i.test(n)) n = "Minecraft " + n;
  return n;
}
function titleMatches(title, term) {
  const tokens = term.toLowerCase().split(/\W+/).filter(t => t.length > 2);
  if (!tokens.length) return false;
  const t = (title || "").toLowerCase();
  return tokens.filter(x => t.includes(x)).length / tokens.length >= 0.6;
}
async function lookup(term) {
  try {   // 1) App Store game icons
    const r = await fetch("https://itunes.apple.com/search?entity=software&limit=5&term=" + encodeURIComponent(term));
    const d = await r.json();
    const hit = (d.results || []).find(x => titleMatches(x.trackName, term));
    if (hit) return hit.artworkUrl100 || hit.artworkUrl512;
  } catch (e) {}
  try {   // 2) Wikipedia article image
    const r = await fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&format=json&origin=*&generator=search&gsrlimit=5" +
      "&gsrsearch=" + encodeURIComponent(term + " video game") + "&prop=pageimages&piprop=thumbnail&pithumbsize=128");
    const d = await r.json();
    const pages = Object.values((d.query || {}).pages || {}).sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
    const hit = pages.find(p => p.thumbnail && titleMatches(p.title, term));
    if (hit) return hit.thumbnail.source;
  } catch (e) {}
  return null;
}

// small queue so we don't fire hundreds of requests at once
const queue = []; let running = 0;
function enqueue(job) { queue.push(job); pump(); }
function pump() {
  while (running < 4 && queue.length) {
    const job = queue.shift(); running++;
    job().finally(() => { running--; pump(); });
  }
}
function showImg(el, url) {
  const img = new Image();
  img.alt = "";
  img.onload = () => { el.textContent = ""; el.appendChild(img); };
  img.src = url;
}
function loadIcon(el, file) {
  if (file in cache) { if (cache[file]) showImg(el, cache[file]); return; }
  enqueue(async () => {
    const url = await lookup(searchTerm(file));
    cache[file] = url || "";
    saveCache();
    if (url) showImg(el, url);
  });
}
const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
  for (const e of entries) {
    if (e.isIntersecting) { observer.unobserve(e.target); loadIcon(e.target, e.target.dataset.file); }
  }
}, { rootMargin: "200px" });

function render() {
  const term = q.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const shown = files.filter(f => displayName(f[0]).toLowerCase().includes(term));
  list.textContent = "";
  for (const [name, size] of shown) {
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.className = "item";
    a.href = CDN + enc(name);
    a.target = "_blank";
    a.rel = "noopener";
    a.title = (size / 1048576).toFixed(1) + " MB";
    const ico = document.createElement("span");
    ico.className = "ico";
    ico.dataset.file = name;
    ico.textContent = (displayName(name).match(/[A-Za-z0-9]/) || ["?"])[0].toUpperCase();
    const label = document.createElement("span");
    label.textContent = displayName(name);
    a.append(ico, label);
    list.appendChild(a);
    observer.observe(ico);
  }
  return shown.length;
}

(async () => {
  let note = "";
  try {
    files = await fromJsDelivr();
  } catch (e1) {
    try { files = await fromGitHub(); }
    catch (e2) { files = FALLBACK; note = " (live lookup failed — showing the built-in list of 378 files)"; }
  }
  files = files.filter(f => f[0].toLowerCase().endsWith(".svg")).sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
  const total = files.length;
  files = files.filter(f => f[1] <= MAX_BYTES);
  hidden = total - files.length;
  const hid = hidden ? ` (${hidden} hidden for being over 20 MB)` : "";
  render();
  status.textContent = `${files.length} SVG files, each linking to cdn.jsdelivr.net${hid}${note}`;
  q.addEventListener("input", () => {
    const c = render();
    status.textContent = `${c} of ${files.length} SVG files shown${hid}${note}`;
  });
})();

// ---------- settings: backgrounds ----------
(() => {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const DARK = { "--fg":"#f1f5f9", "--muted":"#cbd5e1", "--card":"rgba(0,0,0,.35)", "--line":"rgba(255,255,255,.2)", "--accent":"#8ec5ff", "--bg":"#1e293b" };
  const LIGHT = { "--fg":"#1b1f23", "--muted":"#555", "--card":"rgba(255,255,255,.8)", "--line":"#cfd5db", "--accent":"#2563eb", "--bg":"#ffffff" };
  const PRESETS = [
    { id:"default", label:"Default" },
    { id:"midnight", label:"Midnight", css:"linear-gradient(135deg,#0f172a,#1e293b)", dark:true },
    { id:"ocean", label:"Ocean", css:"linear-gradient(135deg,#0f2027,#203a43,#2c5364)", dark:true },
    { id:"sunset", label:"Sunset", css:"linear-gradient(135deg,#ff7e5f,#6a3093)", dark:true },
    { id:"forest", label:"Forest", css:"linear-gradient(135deg,#134e4a,#14532d)", dark:true },
    { id:"orange", label:"Orange", css:"linear-gradient(135deg,#3a210f,#15100c)", dark:true },
    { id:"snow", label:"Snow", css:"linear-gradient(135deg,#f5f7fa,#dfe6ee)", dark:false },
    { id:"grape", label:"Grape", css:"linear-gradient(135deg,#2e1065,#4c1d95)", dark:true }
  ];
  const store = {
    get() { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("bgCfg") || "null"); } catch (e) { return null; } },
    set(v) { try { localStorage.setItem("bgCfg", JSON.stringify(v)); } catch (e) {} }
  };

  function setVars(v) { for (const k in v) root.style.setProperty(k, v[k]); }
  function clearAll() {
    for (const k of Object.keys(DARK)) root.style.removeProperty(k);
    document.body.style.background = "";
    document.body.style.backgroundAttachment = "";
  }
  function paint(bg, dark) {
    clearAll();
    setVars(dark ? DARK : LIGHT);
    document.body.style.background = bg;
    document.body.style.backgroundAttachment = "fixed";
    document.body.style.backgroundSize = "cover";
  }
  function apply(cfg) {
    markSelected(cfg);
    if (!cfg || (cfg.type === "preset" && cfg.value === "default")) { clearAll(); return; }
    if (cfg.type === "preset") {
      const p = PRESETS.find(x => x.id === cfg.value);
      if (p && p.css) paint(p.css, p.dark);
    } else if (cfg.type === "color") {
      const h = cfg.value.replace("#", "");
      const lum = (0.299 * parseInt(h.slice(0,2),16) + 0.587 * parseInt(h.slice(2,4),16) + 0.114 * parseInt(h.slice(4,6),16)) / 255;
      paint(cfg.value, lum < 0.6);
    } else if (cfg.type === "image") {
      const u = String(cfg.value).replace(/"/g, "%22");
      paint(`linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,.45),rgba(0,0,0,.45)), url("${u}") center/cover`, true);
    }
  }
  function choose(cfg) { store.set(cfg); apply(cfg); }

  const sw = document.getElementById("swatches");
  for (const p of PRESETS) {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.type = "button"; b.className = "sw"; b.dataset.id = p.id; b.textContent = p.label;
    b.style.background = p.css || "var(--card)";
    if (!p.css) { b.style.color = "var(--fg)"; b.style.textShadow = "none"; }
    b.addEventListener("click", () => choose({ type:"preset", value:p.id }));
    sw.appendChild(b);
  }
  function markSelected(cfg) {
    const id = cfg ? (cfg.type === "preset" ? cfg.value : null) : "default";
    sw.querySelectorAll(".sw").forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("on", b.dataset.id === id));
  }

  document.getElementById("colorPick").addEventListener("input", e => choose({ type:"color", value:e.target.value }));
  document.getElementById("imgGo").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const v = document.getElementById("imgUrl").value.trim();
    if (v) choose({ type:"image", value:v });
  });
  document.getElementById("imgFile").addEventListener("change", e => {
    const f = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
    if (!f) return;
    const r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = () => choose({ type:"image", value:r.result });   // may be too large to remember; still applies now
    r.readAsDataURL(f);
  });
  document.getElementById("resetBg").addEventListener("click", () => choose({ type:"preset", value:"default" }));

  const panel = document.getElementById("settings");
  const btn = document.getElementById("settingsBtn");
  btn.addEventListener("click", e => { e.stopPropagation(); panel.classList.toggle("open"); });
  document.addEventListener("click", e => { if (!panel.contains(e.target) && e.target !== btn) panel.classList.remove("open"); });

  apply(store.get());
})();

function safeKey(name) {
  return String(name).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/g, "_").slice(0, 40);
}

// ---------- username registration ----------
(() => {
  const gate = document.getElementById("gate");
  const name = document.getElementById("gateName");
  const go = document.getElementById("gateGo");
  const logoutBtn = document.getElementById("logoutBtn");
  const switchBtn = document.createElement("button");
  switchBtn.id = "gateSwitch";
  switchBtn.className = "small";
  switchBtn.type = "button";
  switchBtn.textContent = "Switch user";
  document.getElementById("gateBox").appendChild(switchBtn);

  const readLocalUsers = () => {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("registeredUsers") || "[]"); }
    catch (_) { return []; }
  };
  const saveLocalUser = value => {
    const users = readLocalUsers();
    if (!users.some(x => x.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())) users.push(value);
    localStorage.setItem("registeredUsers", JSON.stringify(users));
  };

  async function registerCloud(value) {
    if (!db) return;
    const key = safeKey(value);
    await db.ref("orangees/users/" + key).set({
      name: value,
      lastSeen: Date.now()
    });
  }

  function enter() {
    const v = name.value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 24);
    if (!v) { name.focus(); return; }
    localStorage.setItem("visitorName", v);
    saveLocalUser(v);
    registerCloud(v).catch(() => {});
    gate.classList.add("hidden");
    if (window.checkUserPopups) window.checkUserPopups();
  }
  const saved = localStorage.getItem("visitorName");
  if (saved) {
    saveLocalUser(saved);
    registerCloud(saved).catch(() => {});
    gate.classList.add("hidden");
  } else {
    name.focus();
  }
  function logout() {
    localStorage.removeItem("visitorName");
    name.value = "";
    gate.classList.remove("hidden");
    name.focus();
  }
  logoutBtn.addEventListener("click", logout);
  go.addEventListener("click", enter);
  name.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter") enter(); });
  switchBtn.addEventListener("click", logout);
})();

// ---------- admin bar + cross-device popups ----------
(() => {
  const ADMIN_PASSWORD = "OrangeesXero";
  const bar = document.getElementById("adminBar");
  const prompt = document.getElementById("adminPrompt");
  const menu = document.getElementById("adminMenu");
  const userInput = document.getElementById("adminUser");
  const err = document.getElementById("adminErr");
  const who = document.getElementById("adminWho");
  const maint = document.getElementById("maintOverlay");
  const flash = document.getElementById("flashOverlay");
  const flashText = document.getElementById("flashText");

  function openBar() {
    bar.classList.add("open");
    const unlocked = sessionStorage.getItem("adminUnlocked") === "1";
    if (unlocked) {
      const visitor = localStorage.getItem("visitorName") || "admin";
      who.textContent = "Admin mode (" + visitor + ")" + (db ? " · cloud ON" : " · cloud OFF");
      prompt.style.display = "none"; menu.style.display = "flex";
      refreshUsers();
    } else {
      prompt.style.display = "flex"; menu.style.display = "none";
      err.style.display = "none"; userInput.value = ""; userInput.focus();
    }
  }
  document.getElementById("adminBtn").addEventListener("click", openBar);
  document.getElementById("adminClose").addEventListener("click", () => bar.classList.remove("open"));

  document.getElementById("adminGo").addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (userInput.value === ADMIN_PASSWORD) {
      sessionStorage.setItem("adminUnlocked", "1");
      err.style.display = "none";
      openBar();
    } else {
      err.style.display = "inline";
    }
  });
  userInput.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter") document.getElementById("adminGo").click(); });

  document.getElementById("admLogout").addEventListener("click", () => {
    sessionStorage.removeItem("adminUnlocked");
    openBar();
  });
  document.getElementById("admSettings").addEventListener("click", () => {
    bar.classList.remove("open");
    document.getElementById("settings").classList.add("open");
  });
  document.getElementById("admMaint").addEventListener("click", () => { maint.classList.add("open"); bar.classList.remove("open"); });
  document.getElementById("maintExit").addEventListener("click", () => maint.classList.remove("open"));
  document.getElementById("admFlash").addEventListener("click", () => {
    flashText.textContent = "DO YOUR WORK";
    flash.classList.add("open"); bar.classList.remove("open");
  });
  document.getElementById("flashExit").addEventListener("click", () => flash.classList.remove("open"));

  const usersEl = document.getElementById("userList");
  const targetEl = document.getElementById("popupTarget");
  const messageEl = document.getElementById("popupMessage");
  const popupStatus = document.getElementById("popupStatus");

  function listUserNames() {
    if (db) {
      return Object.values(cloudUsers)
        .map(u => (u && u.name) || "")
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
    }
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("registeredUsers") || "[]"); }
    catch (_) { return []; }
  }

  function refreshUsers() {
    const users = listUserNames();
    const mode = db ? "Cloud users" : "On this browser only";
    usersEl.textContent = users.length
      ? mode + ": " + users.join(", ")
      : (db ? "No cloud users yet — have people open the page and enter a name." : "No usernames registered on this browser yet.");
    if (!db) {
      usersEl.textContent += " · Paste Firebase config at top of this HTML for cross-device.";
    }
    const previous = targetEl.value;
    targetEl.textContent = "";
    const all = document.createElement("option");
    all.value = "*"; all.textContent = "All users";
    targetEl.appendChild(all);
    for (const user of users) {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = user; opt.textContent = user;
      targetEl.appendChild(opt);
    }
    if ([...targetEl.options].some(o => o.value === previous)) targetEl.value = previous;
  }

  let activePopupId = null;
  let activeIsHard = false;

  function pendingFor(current) {
    if (db) {
      return Object.entries(cloudPopups)
        .map(([id, n]) => ({ id, ...(n || {}) }))
        .filter(n => {
          if (!n.message) return false;
          const seen = n.seenBy || {};
          const me = safeKey(current);
          if (seen[me]) return false;
          return n.to === "*" || (n.to && n.to.toLowerCase() === current.toLowerCase());
        })
        .sort((a, b) => (a.at || 0) - (b.at || 0));
    }
    let notices = [];
    try { notices = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("userPopups") || "[]"); } catch (_) {}
    return notices.filter(n => {
      const seenBy = Array.isArray(n.seenBy) ? n.seenBy : [];
      return !seenBy.some(x => x.toLowerCase() === current.toLowerCase()) &&
        (n.to === "*" || (n.to && n.to.toLowerCase() === current.toLowerCase()));
    });
  }

  function showNormalPopup(next) {
    activePopupId = next.id;
    activeIsHard = false;
    const from = next.from || "Someone";
    document.getElementById("userPopupTitle").textContent = "Message from " + from;
    const body = document.getElementById("userPopupBody");
    body.textContent = next.message;
    body.style.color = next.color || "";
    document.getElementById("userPopup").classList.add("open");
  }

  function showHardPopup(next) {
    activePopupId = next.id;
    activeIsHard = true;
    const from = next.from || "Someone";
    document.getElementById("hardPopupFrom").textContent = "Message from " + from;
    const body = document.getElementById("hardPopupBody");
    body.textContent = next.message;
    body.style.color = next.color || "#f1f5f9";
    document.getElementById("hardPopup").classList.add("open");
    // Cannot be closed by recipient — admin uses "Remove hard popups"
  }

  function deliverPopups() {
    if (document.getElementById("userPopup").classList.contains("open")) return;
    if (document.getElementById("hardPopup").classList.contains("open")) return;
    const current = localStorage.getItem("visitorName");
    if (!current) return;
    const pending = pendingFor(current);
    if (!pending.length) return;
    const next = pending[0];
    if (next.hard) showHardPopup(next);
    else showNormalPopup(next);
  }

  async function markPopupSeen() {
    const current = localStorage.getItem("visitorName");
    if (!current || !activePopupId) return;
    if (db) {
      try {
        await db.ref("orangees/popups/" + activePopupId + "/seenBy/" + safeKey(current)).set(current);
      } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    } else {
      let notices = [];
      try { notices = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("userPopups") || "[]"); } catch (_) {}
      for (const n of notices) {
        if (n.id === activePopupId) {
          if (!Array.isArray(n.seenBy)) n.seenBy = [];
          if (!n.seenBy.some(x => x.toLowerCase() === current.toLowerCase())) n.seenBy.push(current);
          break;
        }
      }
      localStorage.setItem("userPopups", JSON.stringify(notices));
    }
    activePopupId = null;
    activeIsHard = false;
  }

  window.checkUserPopups = deliverPopups;
  document.getElementById("userPopupClose").addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (activeIsHard) return;
    markPopupSeen().then(() => {
      document.getElementById("userPopup").classList.remove("open");
      deliverPopups();
    });
  });
  // Block Escape / clicks from dismissing hard popup
  document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && document.getElementById("hardPopup").classList.contains("open")) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
    }
  });

  document.getElementById("refreshUsers").addEventListener("click", refreshUsers);

  document.getElementById("sendPopup").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const message = messageEl.value.trim();
    if (!message) { popupStatus.textContent = "Enter a message first."; return; }
    const target = targetEl.value || "*";
    const color = (document.getElementById("popupColor") && document.getElementById("popupColor").value) || "#f1f5f9";
    const hard = !!(document.getElementById("popupHard") && document.getElementById("popupHard").checked);
    const from = localStorage.getItem("visitorName") || "Admin";
    const id = Date.now() + "-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
    const payload = {
      id,
      to: target,
      message,
      from,
      color,
      hard: !!hard,
      at: Date.now(),
      seenBy: {}
    };

    if (db) {
      try {
        await db.ref("orangees/popups/" + id).set(payload);
        popupStatus.textContent = (hard ? "Hard popup" : "Popup") + " sent as " + from +
          (target === "*" ? " to everyone (cloud)." : " to " + target + " (cloud).");
        messageEl.value = "";
        if (document.getElementById("popupHard")) document.getElementById("popupHard").checked = false;
        deliverPopups();
      } catch (e) {
        popupStatus.textContent = "Cloud send failed: " + (e.message || e);
      }
    } else {
      let notices = [];
      try { notices = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("userPopups") || "[]"); } catch (_) {}
      notices.push({ ...payload, seenBy: [] });
      if (notices.length > 50) notices = notices.slice(-50);
      localStorage.setItem("userPopups", JSON.stringify(notices));
      popupStatus.textContent = "Saved locally only as " + from + ". Paste Firebase config for cross-device.";
      messageEl.value = "";
      if (document.getElementById("popupHard")) document.getElementById("popupHard").checked = false;
      deliverPopups();
    }
  });


  document.getElementById("clearHardPopups").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    let removed = 0;
    if (db) {
      try {
        const snap = await db.ref("orangees/popups").once("value");
        const all = snap.val() || {};
        const updates = {};
        for (const [id, n] of Object.entries(all)) {
          if (n && n.hard) {
            updates[id] = null; // delete
            removed++;
          }
        }
        if (removed) await db.ref("orangees/popups").update(updates);
        popupStatus.textContent = removed
          ? "Removed " + removed + " hard popup(s) for everyone."
          : "No hard popups to remove.";
      } catch (e) {
        popupStatus.textContent = "Clear failed: " + (e.message || e);
      }
    } else {
      let notices = [];
      try { notices = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("userPopups") || "[]"); } catch (_) {}
      const before = notices.length;
      notices = notices.filter(n => !n.hard);
      removed = before - notices.length;
      localStorage.setItem("userPopups", JSON.stringify(notices));
      popupStatus.textContent = removed
        ? "Removed " + removed + " hard popup(s) (this browser)."
        : "No hard popups to remove.";
    }
    // Close hard overlay on this device immediately
    document.getElementById("hardPopup").classList.remove("open");
    activePopupId = null;
    activeIsHard = false;
  });

  // Live cloud listeners
  if (db) {
    db.ref("orangees/users").on("value", snap => {
      cloudUsers = snap.val() || {};
      refreshUsers();
    });
    db.ref("orangees/popups").on("value", snap => {
      cloudPopups = snap.val() || {};
      // prune old popups (>7 days) quietly from client view only; admin can clean in console
      deliverPopups();
    });
  } else {
    window.addEventListener("storage", e => {
      if (e.key === "userPopups" || e.key === "registeredUsers") {
        refreshUsers();
        deliverPopups();
      }
    });
    setInterval(() => { if (localStorage.getItem("visitorName")) deliverPopups(); }, 2500);
  }

  refreshUsers();
  if (localStorage.getItem("visitorName")) deliverPopups();
})();
</script>


</body></html>
